podcast.body: This song is Dave Grohl's sole original songwriting contribution to the Nirvana catalog. He wrote and initially recorded it in 1990, releasing it on an indie cassette under the moniker Late! A different version was recorded for Nirvana's *In Utero* album and included as a bonus track on the "Heart-Shaped Box" CD single. "Dave Groll's loan contribution to the Nirvana songwriting catalog Merrigold a bonus track from the heart shaped box CD single."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This was Dave Grohl's only songwriting contribution to Nirvana, found on the CD single release for "Heart-Shaped Box" in 1993. "he got to contribute just one song to the band and to find it, you have to go deep into the CD single release for Heart Shape Box in 1993 for a song called Marigold."
